text:
in this exercise, you will apply an image sequence as texture object blender, render a final blender animation sequence, and import it into after effects. create compressed video web streaming format called h.264. 
learning objectives

become familiarized with adding sequences moving textures on 3d geometry.
practice rendering producing files capable to be streamed online.

instructions

watch the tutorials.
create set project folder lastname-animated-textures save your .blend file folder.
download zip file.
create following:

eevee engine (cycles is fine, but may require too much time for exercise)
a polygonal model of television use animated screen sequence.
3 seconds (72 frames animation)

following importing exporting tutorials. defaults at 30 fps, which incorrect. right click footage choose interpret â main. change frame rate 24fps.
